# Securevision

> Securevision is a Singapore-based licensed security engineering company (established in 2006) providing integrated security systems — CCTV surveillance, door access control, video intercoms, vehicle gantry LPR barriers, burglar alarms, and network infrastructure. They design unified, high-reliability security architectures for condominiums (MCSTs), commercial offices, industrial hubs, data centres, landed homes, and healthcare facilities. PLRD Licence: L/PS/000267/2023P.

> For the full sitemap, see https://www.securevision.com.sg/sitemap.xml

- [/insights/condo-intercom-upgrade.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/condo-intercom-upgrade.html) - Condominium Intercom Upgrade Singapore — When Should Your Estate Start Planning?: Decision framework for MCSTs evaluating whether to repair or replace ageing intercom infrastructure.
- [/insights/lpr-vs-rfid-condo.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/lpr-vs-rfid-condo.html) - LPR vs RFID — Which Vehicle Access System Is Better For Your Condo?: Technical comparison of licence plate recognition and RFID vehicle access for Singapore condominium car parks.
- [/insights/condo-security-upgrade-proposals.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/condo-security-upgrade-proposals.html) - Why Some Condo Security Upgrade Proposals Get Approved — And Others Fail: What separates successful AGM proposals from those that stall — scope, cost presentation, and resident communication.
- [/insights/security-upgrade-condo-agm.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/security-upgrade-condo-agm.html) - How to Get a Security Upgrade Approved at a Condo AGM: Step-by-step guide to building a compelling case for the AGM floor, from needs assessment to motion drafting.
- [/insights/mcst-security-tender.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/mcst-security-tender.html) - We Got AGM Approval. Now How Do We Get Meaningful Security Quotes?: How to structure a security tender after AGM approval to get comparable, evaluable quotations from contractors.

### Contractor Selection & Regulation

- [/insights/singapore-licensing.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/singapore-licensing.html) - Why Security System Installers Must Be Licensed in Singapore: Explains the PLRD licensing regime, what licence classes cover, and how to verify a contractor's standing.

### Technical & Compliance

- [/insights/cctv-pdpa-compliance.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/cctv-pdpa-compliance.html) - CCTV and PDPA Compliance in Singapore: What property owners and MCSTs must do to keep CCTV installations compliant with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act.
- [/insights/intercom-system-evolution-singapore.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/intercom-system-evolution-singapore.html) - IP Intercom vs Traditional Intercom — What Changed and Why It Matters for Your Property: Technical comparison of analogue and IP intercom architectures, with guidance on retrofit vs full replacement.
- [/insights/network-security-systems.html](https://www.securevision.com.sg/insights/network-security-systems.html) - The Cameras Were Fine. The Network Was the Problem.: Field case study on how inadequate network infrastructure causes CCTV and access control failures — even with quality equipment.
